title: Random Recursive Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00541v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo infe

translated_abstract: 递归模型通过参数复用创造计算深度，为单纯扩大模型规模提供了一种参数效率更高的替代方案。然而，大多数递归模型要么反复应用同一个学习到的变换，要么应用一个预先规定的变换序列，将计算限制在固定的层顺序上。我们提出了随机递归模型（RRM），该模型维护一个包含 L 个学习层的池，并通过为每个样本和每一步独立有放回地采样一个层来执行 T 个递归步骤。这在保留递归参数效率的同时，实现了灵活的层复用。我们在具有挑战性的推理任务上评估了 RRM，其表现与基线相当甚至更优，且参数量通常减少 50-75%。RRM 可以在推理时改变其计算深度，包括超出训练时所见的深度，而无需重新训练或增加参数，从而提升了受益于更深层迭代计算的任务的表现。RRM 还支持蒙特卡洛推断（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 随机递归模型通过有放回地随机采样网络层来执行递归计算，在参数量减少50-75%的情况下匹配或超越传统递归模型，并可在推理时灵活调整计算深度而无需重新训练。
en_tdlr: The Random Recursive Model (RRM) performs recursion by independently sampling layers with replacement from a pool, matching or exceeding baselines on reasoning tasks with 50-75% fewer parameters while enabling flexible inference-time depth variation without retraining.
